name: LeanCert.Cert.verify_rat_interval
statement:
theorem verify_rat_interval {value : ℝ} {lower upper lo hi : ℚ}
    (hlower : (lower : ℝ) ≤ value)
    (hupper : value ≤ (upper : ℝ))
    (hcheck : checkRatInterval lower upper lo hi = true) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ value ∧ value ≤ (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.Cert.verify_rat_lower
statement:
theorem verify_rat_lower {value : ℝ} {lower lo : ℚ}
    (hlower : (lower : ℝ) ≤ value)
    (hcheck : checkRatLower lower lo = true) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ value

name: LeanCert.Cert.verify_rat_upper
statement:
theorem verify_rat_upper {value : ℝ} {upper hi : ℚ}
    (hupper : value ≤ (upper : ℝ))
    (hcheck : checkRatUpper upper hi = true) :
    value ≤ (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.stepLowerRat_le_stepSum
statement:
theorem stepLowerRat_le_stepSum (S : StepFn) (m N : Nat) :
    (stepLowerRat S m N : ℝ) ≤ stepSum S m N

name: LeanCert.ANT.stepSum_le_stepUpperRat
statement:
theorem stepSum_le_stepUpperRat (S : StepFn) (m N : Nat) :
    stepSum S m N ≤ (stepUpperRat S m N : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_stepSum_interval
statement:
theorem verify_stepSum_interval (S : StepFn) (m N : Nat) (lo hi : ℚ)
    (hcheck : checkStepSumInterval S m N lo hi = true) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ stepSum S m N ∧ stepSum S m N ≤ (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_stepSum_lower
statement:
theorem verify_stepSum_lower (S : StepFn) (m N : Nat) (lo : ℚ)
    (hcheck : checkStepSumLower S m N lo = true) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ stepSum S m N

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_stepSum_upper
statement:
theorem verify_stepSum_upper (S : StepFn) (m N : Nat) (hi : ℚ)
    (hcheck : checkStepSumUpper S m N hi = true) :
    stepSum S m N ≤ (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.finiteLogProduct_le_logProductUpperRat
statement:
theorem finiteLogProduct_le_logProductUpperRat
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (hi : Nat → ℚ)
    (hhi : ∀ n ∈ S, Real.log (g n) ≤ (hi n : ℝ)) :
    finiteLogProduct S g ≤ (logProductUpperRat S hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.finiteProduct_eq_exp_finiteLogProduct
statement:
theorem finiteProduct_eq_exp_finiteLogProduct
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 < g n) :
    finiteProduct S g = Real.exp (finiteLogProduct S g)

name: LeanCert.ANT.logProductLowerRat_le_finiteLogProduct
statement:
theorem logProductLowerRat_le_finiteLogProduct
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (lo : Nat → ℚ)
    (hlo : ∀ n ∈ S, (lo n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (g n)) :
    (logProductLowerRat S lo : ℝ) ≤ finiteLogProduct S g

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_logProduct_interval
statement:
theorem verify_logProduct_interval
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (lo hi : Nat → ℚ)
    (hlo : ∀ n ∈ S, (lo n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (g n))
    (hhi : ∀ n ∈ S, Real.log (g n) ≤ (hi n : ℝ))
    (targetLo targetHi : ℚ)
    (hcheck : checkLogProductInterval S lo hi targetLo targetHi = true) :
    (targetLo : ℝ) ≤ finiteLogProduct S g ∧
      finiteLogProduct S g ≤ (targetHi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_product_interval_of_log_interval
statement:
theorem verify_product_interval_of_log_interval
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (lo hi : ℚ)
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 < g n)
    (hlog : (lo : ℝ) ≤ finiteLogProduct S g ∧ finiteLogProduct S g ≤ (hi : ℝ)) :
    Real.exp (lo : ℝ) ≤ finiteProduct S g ∧
      finiteProduct S g ≤ Real.exp (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_product_lower_of_log_lower
statement:
theorem verify_product_lower_of_log_lower
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (lo : ℚ)
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 < g n)
    (hlog : (lo : ℝ) ≤ finiteLogProduct S g) :
    Real.exp (lo : ℝ) ≤ finiteProduct S g

name: LeanCert.ANT.verify_product_upper_of_log_upper
statement:
theorem verify_product_upper_of_log_upper
    (S : Finset Nat) (g : Nat → ℝ) (hi : ℚ)
    (hpos : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 < g n)
    (hlog : finiteLogProduct S g ≤ (hi : ℝ)) :
    finiteProduct S g ≤ Real.exp (hi : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_add
statement:
theorem evalAlong_add (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (add e₁ e₂) ρ idx = fun t => evalAlong e₁ ρ idx t + evalAlong e₂ ρ idx t

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_add_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_add_pi (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (add e₁ e₂) ρ idx = evalAlong e₁ ρ idx + evalAlong e₂ ρ idx

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_arsinh
statement:
theorem evalAlong_arsinh (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (arsinh e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.arsinh (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_at_ρ
statement:
theorem evalAlong_at_ρ (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong e ρ idx (ρ idx) = eval ρ e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_atan
statement:
theorem evalAlong_atan (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (atan e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.arctan (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_atanh
statement:
theorem evalAlong_atanh (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (atanh e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.atanh (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_const'
statement:
theorem evalAlong_const' (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) (q : ℚ) :
    evalAlong (const q) ρ idx = fun _ => (q : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_cos
statement:
theorem evalAlong_cos (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (cos e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.cos (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_eq
statement:
theorem evalAlong_eq (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) (t : ℝ) :
    evalAlong e ρ idx t = eval (ρ[idx ↦ t]) e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_exp
statement:
theorem evalAlong_exp (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (exp e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.exp (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_inv
statement:
theorem evalAlong_inv (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (inv e) ρ idx = fun t => (evalAlong e ρ idx t)⁻¹

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_log
statement:
theorem evalAlong_log (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (log e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.log (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_mul
statement:
theorem evalAlong_mul (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (mul e₁ e₂) ρ idx = fun t => evalAlong e₁ ρ idx t * evalAlong e₂ ρ idx t

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_mul_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_mul_pi (e₁ e₂ : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (mul e₁ e₂) ρ idx = evalAlong e₁ ρ idx * evalAlong e₂ ρ idx

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_neg
statement:
theorem evalAlong_neg (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (neg e) ρ idx = fun t => -(evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_neg_pi
statement:
theorem evalAlong_neg_pi (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (neg e) ρ idx = -evalAlong e ρ idx

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_sin
statement:
theorem evalAlong_sin (e : Expr) (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (sin e) ρ idx = fun t => Real.sin (evalAlong e ρ idx t)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_var_active
statement:
theorem evalAlong_var_active (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    evalAlong (var idx) ρ idx = id

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.evalAlong_var_passive
statement:
theorem evalAlong_var_passive (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx i : Nat) (h : i ≠ idx) :
    evalAlong (var i) ρ idx = fun _ => ρ i

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_1d_equiv
statement:
theorem eval_1d_equiv (e : Expr) (he : e.usesOnlyVar0 = true) (x : ℝ) :
    eval (fun n => if n = 0 then x else 0) e = eval (fun _ => x) e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs
statement:
theorem eval_abs (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) :
    eval ρ (abs e) = |eval ρ e|

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs_of_neg
statement:
theorem eval_abs_of_neg (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hneg : eval ρ e < 0) :
    eval ρ (abs e) = -(eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_abs_of_pos
statement:
theorem eval_abs_of_pos (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hpos : 0 < eval ρ e) :
    eval ρ (abs e) = eval ρ e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_add (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :
    eval ρ (add e₁ e₂) = eval ρ e₁ + eval ρ e₂

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_arsinh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_arsinh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (arsinh e) = Real.arsinh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_atan
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_atan (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (atan e) = Real.arctan (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_atanh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_atanh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (atanh e) = Real.atanh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_box1d_eq_eval1d
statement:
theorem eval_box1d_eq_eval1d (e : Expr) (he : e.usesOnlyVar0 = true) (x : ℝ) :
    eval (fun n => if n = 0 then x else 0) e = eval (fun _ => x) e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_const (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (q : ℚ) : eval ρ (const q) = q

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_cos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_cos (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (cos e) = Real.cos (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_cosh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_cosh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (cosh e) = Real.cosh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_div (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :
    eval ρ (div e₁ e₂) = eval ρ e₁ / eval ρ e₂

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_erf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_erf (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (erf e) = Real.erf (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_eulerMascheroni
statement:
theorem eval_eulerMascheroni (ρ : Nat → ℝ) :
    eval ρ (namedConst .eulerMascheroni) = Real.eulerMascheroniConstant

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_exp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_exp (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (exp e) = Real.exp (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_inv (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (inv e) = (eval ρ e)⁻¹

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_log
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_log (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (log e) = Real.log (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_mul (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :
    eval ρ (mul e₁ e₂) = eval ρ e₁ * eval ρ e₂

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_namedConst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_namedConst (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (c : MathConst) :
    eval ρ (namedConst c) = c.toReal

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_neg (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (neg e) = -(eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_pow (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (n : ℕ) :
    eval ρ (pow e n) = (eval ρ e) ^ n

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sin (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (sin e) = Real.sin (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sinc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sinc (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (sinc e) = Real.sinc (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sinh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sinh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (sinh e) = Real.sinh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sqrt (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (sqrt e) = Real.sqrt (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs
statement:
theorem eval_sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) :
    eval ρ (sqrt (mul e e)) = |eval ρ e|

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sqrt_sq_of_pos
statement:
theorem eval_sqrt_sq_of_pos (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) (hpos : 0 < eval ρ e) :
    eval ρ (sqrt (mul e e)) = eval ρ e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_sub (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e₁ e₂ : Expr) :
    eval ρ (sub e₁ e₂) = eval ρ e₁ - eval ρ e₂

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_tanh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_tanh (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (e : Expr) : eval ρ (tanh e) = Real.tanh (eval ρ e)

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_usesOnlyVar0_eq
statement:
theorem eval_usesOnlyVar0_eq (e : Expr) (he : e.usesOnlyVar0 = true)
    (ρ₁ ρ₂ : Nat → ℝ) (h0 : ρ₁ 0 = ρ₂ 0) :
    eval ρ₁ e = eval ρ₂ e

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.eval_var
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_var (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) : eval ρ (var idx) = ρ idx

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs
statement: theorem sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs (x : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (x * x) = |x|

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.updateVar_other
statement:
@[simp]
theorem updateVar_other (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx i : Nat) (x : ℝ) (h : i ≠ idx) :
    updateVar ρ idx x i = ρ i

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.updateVar_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem updateVar_same (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) (x : ℝ) :
    updateVar ρ idx x idx = x

name: LeanCert.Core.Expr.updateVar_self
statement:
theorem updateVar_self (ρ : Nat → ℝ) (idx : Nat) :
    updateVar ρ idx (ρ idx) = ρ

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_arg_pos
statement: theorem Real.atanh_arg_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) : 0 < (1 + x) / (1 - x)

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_mono
statement:
theorem Real.atanh_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) (hy : |y| < 1) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    Real.atanh x ≤ Real.atanh y

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_neg
statement: theorem Real.atanh_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) : Real.atanh (-x) = -Real.atanh x

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem Real.atanh_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn Real.atanh (Set.Ioo (-1) 1)

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.atanh_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Real.atanh_zero : Real.atanh 0 = 0

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.erf_le_one
statement: theorem Real.erf_le_one (x : ℝ) : Real.erf x ≤ 1

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.erf_mem_Icc
statement: theorem Real.erf_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : Real.erf x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.neg_one_le_erf
statement: theorem Real.neg_one_le_erf (x : ℝ) : -1 ≤ Real.erf x

name: LeanCert.Core.Real.sinc_mem_Icc
statement: theorem Real.sinc_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : Real.sinc x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

name: LeanCert.Core.Icc_compact
statement: theorem Icc_compact (a b : ℝ) : IsCompact (Set.Icc a b)

name: LeanCert.Core.Icc_convex
statement: theorem Icc_convex (a b : ℝ) : Convex ℝ (Set.Icc a b)

name: LeanCert.Core.add_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem add_mem_Icc {x y a b c d : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc c d) :
    x + y ∈ Set.Icc (a + c) (b + d)

name: LeanCert.Core.continuous_Icc_bounds
statement:
theorem continuous_Icc_bounds {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    ∃ (lo hi : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, lo ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ hi) ∧
      (∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = lo) ∧ (∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = hi)

name: LeanCert.Core.mem_Icc_iff
statement: theorem mem_Icc_iff (x a b : ℝ) : mem_Icc x a b ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc a b

name: LeanCert.Core.neg_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem neg_mem_Icc {x a b : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    -x ∈ Set.Icc (-b) (-a)

name: LeanCert.Core.sub_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem sub_mem_Icc {x y a b c d : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc c d) :
    x - y ∈ Set.Icc (a - d) (b - c)

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.all_le_max4
statement:
theorem all_le_max4 (a b c d : ℚ) :
    a ≤ max4 a b c d ∧ b ≤ max4 a b c d ∧ c ≤ max4 a b c d ∧ d ≤ max4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_max4_of_ge
statement:
theorem eq_max4_of_ge {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : b ≤ a) (h2 : c ≤ a) (h3 : d ≤ a) :
    a = max4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_max4_of_ge2
statement:
theorem eq_max4_of_ge2 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : c ≤ b) (h3 : d ≤ b) :
    b = max4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_max4_of_ge3
statement:
theorem eq_max4_of_ge3 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : a ≤ c) (h2 : b ≤ c) (h3 : d ≤ c) :
    c = max4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_max4_of_ge4
statement:
theorem eq_max4_of_ge4 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : a ≤ d) (h2 : b ≤ d) (h3 : c ≤ d) :
    d = max4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_min4_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_min4_of_le {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : a ≤ c) (h3 : a ≤ d) :
    a = min4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_min4_of_le2
statement:
theorem eq_min4_of_le2 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : b ≤ a) (h2 : b ≤ c) (h3 : b ≤ d) :
    b = min4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_min4_of_le3
statement:
theorem eq_min4_of_le3 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : c ≤ a) (h2 : c ≤ b) (h3 : c ≤ d) :
    c = min4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.eq_min4_of_le4
statement:
theorem eq_min4_of_le4 {a b c d : ℚ} (h1 : d ≤ a) (h2 : d ≤ b) (h3 : d ≤ c) :
    d = min4 a b c d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.exists_mem_iff_exists_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iff_exists_Icc {P : ℝ → Prop} (I : IntervalRat) :
    (∃ x ∈ I, P x) ↔ (∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (I.lo : ℝ) (I.hi : ℝ), P x)

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.forall_mem_iff_forall_Icc
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff_forall_Icc {P : ℝ → Prop} (I : IntervalRat) :
    (∀ x ∈ I, P x) ↔ (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (I.lo : ℝ) (I.hi : ℝ), P x)

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.hi_sub_midpoint
statement:
theorem hi_sub_midpoint (I : IntervalRat) :
    (I.hi : ℝ) - I.midpoint = (I.hi - I.lo) / 2

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.intersect_subset_left
statement:
theorem intersect_subset_left {I J K : IntervalRat} (h : intersect I J = some K) :
    K.lo ≥ I.lo ∧ K.hi ≤ I.hi

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.intersect_subset_right
statement:
theorem intersect_subset_right {I J K : IntervalRat} (h : intersect I J = some K) :
    K.lo ≥ J.lo ∧ K.hi ≤ J.hi

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.le_min4_iff
statement:
theorem le_min4_iff (x a b c d : ℚ) :
    x ≤ min4 a b c d ↔ x ≤ a ∧ x ≤ b ∧ x ≤ c ∧ x ≤ d

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.max4_le_iff
statement:
theorem max4_le_iff (x a b c d : ℚ) :
    max4 a b c d ≤ x ↔ a ≤ x ∧ b ≤ x ∧ c ≤ x ∧ d ≤ x

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.mem_add
statement:
theorem mem_add {x y : ℝ} {I J : IntervalRat} (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ J) :
    x + y ∈ add I J

name: LeanCert.Core.IntervalRat.mem_bisect_left

name: LeanCert.Core.taylor_remainder_bound
statement:
theorem taylor_remainder_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b c : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (_hab : a ≤ b) (hca : a ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ n f)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ M)
    (_hMnonneg : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      ‖f x - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (iteratedDeriv i f c / i.factorial) * (x - c) ^ i‖
        ≤ M * |x - c| ^ n / n.factorial

    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hcx : c < x) :
    ‖f x - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (iteratedDeriv i f c / i.factorial) * (x - c) ^ i‖
        ≤ M * |x - c| ^ (m + 1) / (m + 1).factorial

statement:
theorem shift_identity {F : ℂ → ℂ} {σ₀ σ₁ : ℝ}
    (C : ContourShiftCert F σ₀ σ₁) :
    ∃ L₀ L₁ : ℂ,
      Tendsto (fun n => verticalIntegral F σ₀ (C.T n)) atTop (𝓝 L₀) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => verticalIntegral F σ₁ (C.T n)) atTop (𝓝 L₁) ∧
      L₀ = L₁ + (2 * Real.pi * I) * C.residueSum

statement:
theorem vertical_shift (C : VerticalShiftCert) :
    I * rightIntegral C.f C.z C.w =
      I * leftIntegral C.f C.z C.w +
        (2 * Real.pi * I) * C.residueSum -
          bottomIntegral C.f C.z C.w +
            topIntegral C.f C.z C.w

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.H_subquadratic
statement:

    ‖H t z‖ ≤ (44 * (∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-u^2))) *

theorem H_zero_subquadratic (z : ℂ) :

theorem cubic_absorption {u y : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.heatIntegrand_subquadratic

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.subquadratic_exponent

theorem subquadratic_exponent {u y : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.conjugate_pair_shift_difference
statement:
theorem conjugate_pair_shift_difference (z r : ℂ) (a : ℝ) :
    normSq ((z+(a : ℂ)*I-r)*(z+(a : ℂ)*I-conj r)) -
      normSq ((z-(a : ℂ)*I-r)*(z-(a : ℂ)*I-conj r)) =
      8*a*z.im*((z.re-r.re)^2 + z.im^2 + a^2 - r.im^2)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.conjugate_pair_shift_lt
statement:
theorem conjugate_pair_shift_lt {z r : ℂ} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hy : 0 < z.im) (hr : r.im^2 < z.im^2+a^2) :
    normSq ((z-(a : ℂ)*I-r)*(z-(a : ℂ)*I-conj r)) <
      normSq ((z+(a : ℂ)*I-r)*(z+(a : ℂ)*I-conj r))

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.polynomial_shiftAverage_real
statement:
theorem polynomial_shiftAverage_real (p : ℂ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hc : p.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = p) {b a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hba : b^2 ≤ a^2) (hstrip : ∀ r : ℂ, p.eval r = 0 → r.im^2 ≤ b^2)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : shiftAverage p.eval a z = 0) : z.im = 0

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.polynomial_shiftAverage_strip
statement:
theorem polynomial_shiftAverage_strip (p : ℂ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hc : p.map (starRingEnd ℂ) = p) {b a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hstrip : ∀ r : ℂ, p.eval r = 0 → r.im^2 ≤ b^2)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : shiftAverage p.eval a z = 0) :
    z.im^2 ≤ max (b^2-a^2) 0

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.realPolynomial_shiftAverage_strip
statement:
theorem realPolynomial_shiftAverage_strip (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)

    (hstrip : ∀ r : ℂ, (p.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval r = 0 → r.im^2 ≤ b^2)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : shiftAverage (p.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval a z = 0) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.rootProduct_shift_lt
statement:
theorem rootProduct_shift_lt (roots : Multiset ℂ) (hne : roots ≠ 0)
    (hc : roots.map conj = roots) {z : ℂ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hr : ∀ r ∈ roots, r.im^2 < z.im^2+a^2) :
    normSq ((roots.map (fun r => z-(a : ℂ)*I-r)).prod) <
      normSq ((roots.map (fun r => z+(a : ℂ)*I-r)).prod)

statement:
theorem shiftPolynomialIter_real (p : ℂ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)

statement:

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.shiftHeatIntegrand_bound_unit
statement:
theorem shiftHeatIntegrand_bound_unit (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : (n : ℝ)*a^2 = 1)
    (Y : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : |z.im| ≤ Y) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    ‖shiftHeatIntegrand 0 a n z u‖ ≤

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.shiftHeatIntegrand_integrable
statement:
theorem shiftHeatIntegrand_integrable (t a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.unitShift_convergence

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.Phi_four_point_obstruction
statement:
theorem Phi_four_point_obstruction :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.Phi_upper_exp
statement:
theorem Phi_upper_exp {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :

theorem timeShift_budget (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.timeShift_convergence
statement:
theorem timeShift_convergence (t δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :

name: LeanCert.Analysis.DBN.timeShift_joint_tendsto

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.euler_log_remainder_bound
statement:
theorem euler_log_remainder_bound {s u : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 1 ≤ s.im)
    (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ s.im/2) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖(∑ j ∈ range N, Complex.log (1+u/(s+j))) -
      (u*(∑ j ∈ range N, (s+j)⁻¹) - u^2/2*(∑ j ∈ range N, (s+j)⁻¹^2))‖ ≤
        8*‖u‖^3/s.im^2

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.exp_logEulerRatio
statement:
theorem exp_logEulerRatio {s u : ℂ} (hi : 0 < s.im) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ s.im/2) (N : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp (logEulerRatio s u N) =
      Complex.GammaSeq (s+u) (N+1) / Complex.GammaSeq s (N+1)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.exp_logEulerRatio_tendsto
statement:
theorem exp_logEulerRatio_tendsto {s u : ℂ} (hi : 0 < s.im) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ s.im/2) :
    Tendsto (fun N => Complex.exp (logEulerRatio s u N)) atTop
      (𝓝 (Complex.Gamma (s+u)/Complex.Gamma s))

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.harmonic_error_bound
statement:
theorem harmonic_error_bound {s : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 2 ≤ s.im) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖(∑ j ∈ range N, (s+j)⁻¹) - (Complex.log (s+N)-Complex.log s)‖ ≤ 8/s.im

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.inverse_square_error_bound
statement:
theorem inverse_square_error_bound {s : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 1 ≤ s.im) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖(∑ j ∈ range N, (s+j)⁻¹^2) - (s⁻¹-(s+N)⁻¹)‖ ≤ 8/s.im^2

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.logEulerRatio_error_bound
statement:
theorem logEulerRatio_error_bound {s u : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 2 ≤ s.im)
    (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ s.im/2) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖logEulerRatio s u N - (u*Complex.log s+u^2/(2*s))‖ ≤
      ratioError s.im ‖u‖ +
      ‖u‖*‖(Real.log ((N : ℝ)+1) : ℂ)-Complex.log (s+(N+2 : ℕ))‖ +
      (‖u‖^2/2)*‖(s+(N+2 : ℕ))⁻¹‖

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.log_step
statement:
theorem log_step {s : ℂ} (hi : 0 < s.im) :
    Complex.log (1+s⁻¹) = Complex.log (s+1)-Complex.log s

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.relative_error_bound
statement:
theorem relative_error_bound {s u : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 2 ≤ s.im)
    (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ s.im/2) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma (s+u) / Complex.Gamma s /
        Complex.exp (u*Complex.log s+u^2/(2*s)) - 1‖ ≤
      Real.exp (ratioError s.im ‖u‖) - 1

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.relative_error_bound_growing
statement:
theorem relative_error_bound_growing {s u : ℂ} {h : ℝ} (hh : 2 ≤ h)
    (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hy : h^5 ≤ s.im) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ h^3) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma (s+u) / Complex.Gamma s /
        Complex.exp (u*Complex.log s+u^2/(2*s)) - 1‖ ≤ Real.exp (20/h)-1

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.sum_inv_norm_cube_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_norm_cube_le {s : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 1 ≤ s.im) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range N, ‖s+j‖⁻¹^3) ≤ 8/s.im^2

name: LeanCert.Analysis.GammaRatio.sum_inv_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_norm_sq_le {s : ℂ} (hr : 0 ≤ s.re+s.im/2) (hi : 1 ≤ s.im) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range N, ‖s+j‖⁻¹^2) ≤ 8/s.im

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.DerivLadder.pos_of_top
statement:
theorem pos_of_top (k : ℕ) : ∀ (w b : ℝ) (L : DerivLadder k w b),
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < L.f k x) →
    ∀ i ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < L.f i x

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.expm1_div_self_mem
statement:
theorem expm1_div_self_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Real.exp t - 1) / t ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) (Real.exp 1)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.expm1_sub_self_div_sq_mem
statement:
theorem expm1_sub_self_div_sq_mem {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Real.exp t - t - 1) / t ^ 2 ∈ Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) (Real.exp 1 / 2)

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_derivLadder
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_derivLadder {w b lo hi : ℝ} :
    ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ∀ (N D : DerivLadder k w b),
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, 0 < D.f k x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, lo * D.f k x ≤ N.f k x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, N.f k x ≤ hi * D.f k x) →
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo w b, N.f 0 t / D.f 0 t ∈ Icc lo hi

name: LeanCert.Analysis.WallQuotient.quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_of_deriv_ratio_bounds
    {num den num' den' : ℝ → ℝ} {w b lo hi : ℝ}
    (hnum0 : num w = 0) (hden0 : den w = 0)
    (hnumc : ContinuousOn num (Icc w b))
    (hdenc : ContinuousOn den (Icc w b))
    (hnumd : ∀ x ∈ Ioo w b, HasDerivAt num (num' x) x)

statement:
theorem bernstein_enclosure_01 (qs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (hn : qs.length = n + 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    let bs := monomialToBernstein qs
    let bounds := listMinMax bs (bs[0]'(by rw [monomialToBernstein_length qs (by omega)]; omega))
    (bounds.1 : ℝ) ≤
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) ∧
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) ≤
    (bounds.2 : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernstein_nonneg (n k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :

      (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)) = 1

name: LeanCert.Engine.bernstein_representation
statement:
theorem bernstein_representation (qs : List ℚ) (n : ℕ) (hn : qs.length = n + 1)
    (t : ℝ) (_ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (_ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    let bs := monomialToBernstein qs
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun j => (qs.getD j 0 : ℝ) * t ^ j) =
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sum (fun k =>
      (bs.getD k 0 : ℝ) *
      ((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * t ^ k * (1 - t) ^ (n - k)))

statement:
theorem monomialToBernstein_getElem (qs : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < qs.length)
    (hn : 0 < qs.length) :
    (monomialToBernstein qs)[k]'(by rw [monomialToBernstein_length qs hn]; exact hk) =
    (Finset.range (k + 1)).sum (fun j =>
      if hj : j < qs.length then
        if (Nat.choose (qs.length - 1) j) = 0 then 0
        else binomialRat k j / binomialRat (qs.length - 1) j * qs[j]
      else 0)

name: LeanCert.Engine.Affine.AffineVector.mem_centered
LeanCert.Engine.Affine.AffineVector.mem_layerNorm
statement:
theorem mem_layerNorm {v_real : List ℝ} {v : AffineVector}
    {eps : AffineForm.NoiseAssignment}
    (gamma beta : List ℚ)
    (epsilon : ℚ)
    (heps_pos : 0 < epsilon)
    (hvalid : AffineForm.validNoise eps)
    (hmem : mem v_real v eps)
    (hne : ¬v.isEmpty)
    -- Additional hypotheses needed for sqrt and inv
    (hlen_eps : eps.length = (variance v |>.add (AffineForm.const epsilon)).coeffs.length)
    (hlen_sqrt : eps.length = ((variance v).add (AffineForm.const epsilon) |> AffineForm.sqrt).coeffs.length)
    (hsqrt_pos : 0 < ((variance v).add (AffineForm.const epsilon) |> AffineForm.sqrt).toInterval.lo) :
    let μ := v_real.sum / v_real.length
    let variance_real := (v_real.map (fun x => (x - μ) * (x - μ))).sum / v_real.length
    let std_real := Real.sqrt (variance_real + epsilon)
    let inv_std_real := 1 / std_real
    let output_real :=
      List.zipWith3 (fun xi (g : ℚ) (b : ℚ) => (xi - μ) * inv_std_real * (g : ℝ) + b)
        v_real gamma beta
    mem output_real (layerNorm v gamma beta epsilon) eps

    (hmem : mem v_real v eps)
    (hne : ¬v.isEmpty) :

name: LeanCert.Engine.integral_bounds_of_bounds
statement:
theorem integral_bounds_of_bounds {a b lo hi : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b)
    (hlo : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, lo ≤ f x)
    (hhi : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ hi) :
    lo * (b - a) ≤ ∫ x in a..b, f x ∧ ∫ x in a..b, f x ≤ hi * (b - a)

name: LeanCert.Engine.integral_partition_sum
statement:
theorem integral_partition_sum (e : Expr) (I : IntervalRat) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) volume I.lo I.hi) :
    ∫ x in (I.lo : ℝ)..(I.hi : ℝ), Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ x in (partitionPoints I n k)..(partitionPoints I n (k + 1)),
        Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e

name: LeanCert.Engine.integral_split_mid
statement:
theorem integral_split_mid (e : Expr) (I : IntervalRat)
    (hInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) volume I.lo I.hi) :
    ∫ x in (I.lo : ℝ)..(I.hi : ℝ), Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e =
    (∫ x in (I.lo : ℝ)..(I.midpoint : ℝ), Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) +
    (∫ x in (I.midpoint : ℝ)..(I.hi : ℝ), Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e)

name: LeanCert.Engine.integral_subinterval_bounded

    ∫ x in (partitionPoints I n k)..(partitionPoints I n (k + 1)),

name: LeanCert.Engine.ExtendedInterval.foldl_contains_head
statement:
theorem foldl_contains_head (t : List IntervalRat) (h : IntervalRat) :
    let result := t.foldl (fun acc I =>
      { lo := min acc.lo I.lo
        hi := max acc.hi I.hi
        le := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans acc.le (le_max_left _ _)) }) h
    result.lo ≤ h.lo ∧ h.hi ≤ result.hi

      { lo := min acc.lo J.lo
        hi := max acc.hi J.hi
        le := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans acc.le (le_max_left _ _)) }) h
    result.lo ≤ I.lo ∧ I.hi ≤ result.hi

name: LeanCert.Engine.TaylorModel.log_approx_error_bound
statement:
theorem log_approx_error_bound {c : ℚ} (hc_pos : 0 < c) :
    let c_interval : IntervalRat.IntervalRatPos :=
      { toIntervalRat := IntervalRat.singleton c
        lo_pos := by simp only [IntervalRat.singleton]; exact hc_pos }
    let logc_interval := IntervalRat.logInterval c_interval
    let logc_approx := logc_interval.midpoint
    let logc_error := logc_interval.width / 2
    |Real.log c - logc_approx| ≤ logc_error

    (hpos : J.lo > 0) (hc_lo : (J.lo : ℝ) ≤ c) (hc_hi : (c : ℝ) ≤ J.hi)
    (hz : z ∈ J) :
    |Real.log z - Real.log c -
      Polynomial.aeval (z - (c : ℝ)) (logTaylorPolyAtCenter c n)| ≤
    (logLagrangeRemainder J c n : ℝ)

theorem bisectRoot_hasRoot_correct (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e) (I : IntervalRat)
    (maxIter : ℕ) (tol : ℚ) (htol : 0 < tol)
    (hCont : ContinuousOn (fun x => Expr.eval (fun _ => x) e) (Set.Icc I.lo I.hi)) :
    let result := bisectRoot e I maxIter tol htol

name: LeanCert.Engine.newtonStepSimple_extract
statement:
lemma newtonStepSimple_extract (e : Expr) (I N : IntervalRat)
    (hSimple : newtonStepSimple e I 0 = some N) :
    let c := I.midpoint
    let fc := LeanCert.Internal.Rational.evalUnchecked1 e (IntervalRat.singleton c)
    let dI := derivInterval e (fun _ => I) 0
    ∃ (hdI_nonzero : ¬dI.containsZero),
      let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero := ⟨dI, hdI_nonzero⟩
      let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc (IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero)
      N.lo = max I.lo (c - Q.hi) ∧ N.hi = min I.hi (c - Q.lo)

name: LeanCert.Engine.newton_operator_preserves_root
statement:
theorem newton_operator_preserves_root (e : Expr) (hsupp : ADSupported e) (_hvar0 : UsesOnlyVar0 e)
    (I : IntervalRat) (c : ℚ) (fc dI : IntervalRat)
    (hc_in_I : (c : ℝ) ∈ I)
    (hfc : evalFunc1 e c ∈ fc)
    (hdI : ∀ ξ ∈ I, deriv (evalFunc1 e) ξ ∈ dI)
    (hdI_nonzero : ¬IntervalRat.containsZero dI)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ I) (hroot : evalFunc1 e x = 0) :
    -- x is in the Newton operator interval c - fc/dI
    let dNonzero : IntervalRat.IntervalRatNonzero :=
      { lo := dI.lo, hi := dI.hi, le := dI.le, nonzero := hdI_nonzero }
    let dInv := IntervalRat.invNonzero dNonzero
    let Q := IntervalRat.mul fc dInv
    let Newton : IntervalRat := { lo := c - Q.hi, hi := c - Q.lo, le := by linarith [Q.le] }
    x ∈ Newton

name: LeanCert.Engine.adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList
statement:
theorem adjacentAll_of_checkAdjacentList
    {Rel : Row → Row → Prop} {rel : Row → Row → Bool}
    (hsound : ∀ a b, rel a b = true → Rel a b) :
    ∀ {rows : List Row},
      checkAdjacentList rel rows = true → AdjacentAll Rel rows
  | [], _ => AdjacentAll.nil
  | [_], _ => AdjacentAll.singleton _
  | a :: b :: rest, hcheck => by
      simp only [checkAdjacentList] at hcheck
      have hab : rel a b = true

name: LeanCert.ML.Distillation.SequentialNet.mem_forwardInterval
statement:
theorem mem_forwardInterval {net : SequentialNet} {xs : List ℝ} {Is : IntervalVector}
    (hdim : xs.length = Is.length)
    (hwf : WellFormed net xs.length)
    (hmem : ∀ i (hi : i < Is.length), xs[i]'(hdim ▸ hi) ∈ Is[i]'hi)
    (prec : Int) (hprec : prec ≤ 0 := by norm_num) :
    let outReal := forwardReal net xs
    let outInt := forwardInterval net Is prec
    outReal.length = outInt.length ∧
    ∀ i (hi : i < outInt.length), outReal[i]'((forwardLength_aux net.layers xs Is hdim hwf prec) ▸ hi) ∈ outInt[i]'hi

    (prec : Int) (hprec : prec ≤ 0) :
    let outReal := layers.foldl (fun acc l => Layer.forwardReal l acc) xs
    let outInt := layers.foldl (fun acc l => Layer.forwardInterval l acc prec) Is
    ∀ i (hi : i < outInt.length),
      outReal[i]'((forwardLength_aux layers xs Is hdim hwf prec) ▸ hi) ∈ outInt[i]'hi

theorem mem_subVectors {ra rb : List ℝ} {ia ib : IntervalVector}
    (halen : ra.length = ia.length)
    (hblen : rb.length = ib.length)
    (ha : ∀ i (hi : i < ia.length), ra[i]'(halen ▸ hi) ∈ ia[i]'hi)
    (hb : ∀ i (hi : i < ib.length), rb[i]'(hblen ▸ hi) ∈ ib[i]'hi) :
    ∀ i (hi : i < (subVectors ia ib).length),
      (ra[i]'(by simp [subVectors_length] at hi; rw [halen]; omega) -
       rb[i]'(by simp [subVectors_length] at hi; rw [hblen]; omega)) ∈
      (subVectors ia ib)[i]'hi

name: LeanCert.ML.Distillation.verify_equivalence
statement:
theorem verify_equivalence (teacher student : SequentialNet)
    (domain : IntervalVector) (eps : ℚ) (prec : Int)
    (x : List ℝ)
    (hprec : prec ≤ 0)
    (hwf_t : teacher.WellFormed x.length)
    (hwf_s : student.WellFormed x.length)
    (h_dom_len : x.length = domain.length)
    (h_mem : ∀ i (hi : i < domain.length), x[i]'(h_dom_len ▸ hi) ∈ domain[i]'hi)
    (h_cert : checkEquivalence teacher student domain eps prec = true) :
    let t_out := SequentialNet.forwardReal teacher x
    let s_out := SequentialNet.forwardReal student x
    let t_int := SequentialNet.forwardInterval teacher domain prec
    let s_int := SequentialNet.forwardInterval student domain prec
    -- Dimensions match
    t_int.length = s_int.length ∧
    -- All outputs are within eps
    ∀ i (hi_t : i < t_int.length) (hi_s : i < s_int.length),
      |t_out[i]'((SequentialNet.forwardLength_aux teacher.layers x domain h_dom_len hwf_t prec) ▸ hi_t) -
       s_out[i]'((SequentialNet.forwardLength_aux student.layers x domain h_dom_len hwf_s prec) ▸ hi_s)| ≤ (eps : ℝ)

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.forwardQuantized_nonempty
statement:
theorem forwardQuantized_nonempty
    (l_quant : QuantizedLayer)
    (input : AlignedInput)
    (x : List ℝ)
    -- Dimension hypotheses
    (_h_input_dim : x.length = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_lo_dim : input.lo.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_hi_dim : input.hi.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wpos_dim : l_quant.weightsPos.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wneg_dim : l_quant.weightsNeg.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_bias_dim : l_quant.bias.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wpos_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsPos[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wneg_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsNeg[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    -- Positivity invariant
    (h_pos_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsPos[r]!)[c]!)
    (h_neg_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsNeg[r]!)[c]!)
    -- Input containment
    (h_aligned : input.exp = l_quant.commonExp)
    (hx_lo : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → intVal input.lo[k]! input.exp ≤ x[k]!)
    (hx_hi : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → x[k]! ≤ intVal input.hi[k]! input.exp) :
    -- Conclusion: Output interval is non-empty
    ∀ i (_hi : i < l_quant.outDim),
      intVal (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).lo[i]! (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).exp ≤
      intVal (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).hi[i]! (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).exp

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.forwardQuantized_sound
statement:
theorem forwardQuantized_sound
    (l_quant : QuantizedLayer)
    (input : AlignedInput)
    -- Dimension hypotheses
    (h_lo_dim : input.lo.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_hi_dim : input.hi.size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wpos_dim : l_quant.weightsPos.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wneg_dim : l_quant.weightsNeg.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_bias_dim : l_quant.bias.size = l_quant.outDim)
    (h_wpos_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsPos[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    (h_wneg_cols : ∀ r (hr : r < l_quant.outDim), l_quant.weightsNeg[r].size = l_quant.inDim)
    -- Positivity invariant (required for split-sign logic)
    (h_pos_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsPos[r]!)[c]!)
    (h_neg_nonneg : ∀ r c, r < l_quant.outDim → c < l_quant.inDim →
        0 ≤ (l_quant.weightsNeg[r]!)[c]!)
    -- Input bounds validity: lo ≤ hi for each component
    (h_bounds_valid : ∀ k, k < l_quant.inDim → input.lo[k]! ≤ input.hi[k]!)
    -- Already aligned
    (h_aligned : input.exp = l_quant.commonExp) :
    -- Conclusion: Output bounds are valid (lo ≤ hi)
    ∀ idx (_hidx : idx < l_quant.outDim),
      (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).lo[idx]! ≤ (l_quant.forwardQuantized input).hi[idx]!

name: LeanCert.ML.Optimized.QuantizedLayer.split_sign_bounds
statement:
theorem split_sign_bounds
    {n : Nat} (pos neg l u x : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ pos i)
    (hneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ neg i)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≤ x i)
    (hu : ∀ i, x i ≤ u i) :
    let w := fun i => pos i - neg i
    let y := ∑ i, w i * x i
    (∑ i, pos i * l i) - (∑ i, neg i * u i) ≤ y ∧
    y ≤ (∑ i, pos i * u i) - (∑ i, neg i * l i)

    {q : IntervalVector} {K : List IntervalVector}
    (_hq : q_real.length = q.length)
    (hK : K_real.length = K.length)
    -- (membership hypotheses omitted for brevity - same pattern as other theorems)
    (d_k : Nat) (prec : Int) :
    let weights_real := K_real.map (fun k =>
      (List.zipWith (· * ·) q_real k).sum / Real.sqrt d_k)

    {c d c' d' : Nat} (hc : c ∈ S) (hd : d ∈ S) (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (hc' : c' ∈ S) (hd' : d' ∈ S) (hcd' : c' ≠ d')
    (hbase : (S.erase c).erase d = (S.erase c').erase d')
    (hsum : c + d = c' + d') :
    F S - F (S.erase c) - F (S.erase d) + F ((S.erase c).erase d) =
      F S - F (S.erase c') - F (S.erase d') + F ((S.erase c').erase d')

name: LeanCert.Validity.verify_system_root_exists

theorem verify_system_root_exists {n : Nat} (F : Fin n → Expr)
    (X : Fin n → IntervalRat) (cert : KrawczykCert n) (cfg : EvalConfig)
    (h : krawczykCheck F X cert cfg = true) :

name: LeanCert.Validity.verify_system_root_unique

    (hy : FinBoxMem y X ∧ SystemZero F y) : x = y

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.eventually_certifies_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_certifies_lower (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule)
    (lower : Nat → ℝ) {trueBound target margin : ℝ}
    (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    (hstrict : target + margin ≤ trueBound)
    (hlower : ∀ n, trueBound - schedule.totalError n ≤ lower n) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, target < lower n

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.eventually_certifies_upper
statement:
theorem eventually_certifies_upper (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule)
    (upper : Nat → ℝ) {trueBound target margin : ℝ}
    (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    (hstrict : trueBound ≤ target - margin)
    (hupper : ∀ n, upper n ≤ trueBound + schedule.totalError n) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, upper n < target

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.eventually_totalError_lt
statement:
theorem eventually_totalError_lt (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule)
    {margin : ℝ} (hmargin : 0 < margin) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, schedule.totalError n < margin

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.exists_certifying_lower
statement:
theorem exists_certifying_lower (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule)
    (lower : Nat → ℝ) {trueBound target margin : ℝ}
    (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    (hstrict : target + margin ≤ trueBound)
    (hlower : ∀ n, trueBound - schedule.totalError n ≤ lower n) :
    ∃ n, target < lower n

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.exists_certifying_upper

theorem exists_certifying_upper (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule)

    (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    (hstrict : trueBound ≤ target - margin)
    (hupper : ∀ n, upper n ≤ trueBound + schedule.totalError n) :
    ∃ n, upper n < target

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.totalError_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalError_nonneg (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule) (n : Nat) :
    0 ≤ schedule.totalError n

name: LeanCert.Validity.NumericalRefinementSchedule.totalError_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem totalError_tendsto_zero (schedule : NumericalRefinementSchedule) :
    Tendsto schedule.totalError atTop (nhds 0)
